acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira Glass introduces the first episode of a new podcast from longtime This American Life producer and editor Susan Burton.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Susan Burton introduces some of the many women who went to a Yale fertility clinic for IVF treatment, and charts their experience from hopeful beginning to excruciatingly painful egg retrieval.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Often bypassing logic, the women go to great lengths to construct elaborate stories to make sense of their inexplicable pain. And then, a letter arrives.
